prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 公式文本 · 物理量 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "物理量" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "符号" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 3: header "公式" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 91px
  col 4: header "单位" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 77px · one-line width 274px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"A compact physics reference table for looking up quantities, their symbols, defining formulas, SI units, and brief explanatory notes.","reading":"Readers scan row by row from quantity to symbol, formula, and unit, then read the explanation; cross-row comparison concentrates on the formula and unit columns.","groups":["Columns 1–2: quantity name and symbol together identify the row.","Columns 3–4: formula and unit together state the technical definition.","Column 5: explanatory prose that supports the row but is read after the formula."],"keep_intact":["Formula tokens and subscripts, especially unbreakable segments such as G·m₁m₂/r² and ½mv²","Symbols and units, including the em dash placeholders","Short headers 符号 and 单位","Quantity names where possible, though long names can wrap"],"may_wrap":["说明 prose, which can wrap naturally over several lines","Long quantity names such as 理想气体状态方程","Formulas at spaces or operators when the full expression cannot fit on one line"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [90, 52, 112, 52, 173] · table 480×275px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [84, 52, 112, 52, 179] · table 480×252px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [84, 52, 119, 52, 172] · table 480×275px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"物理量 at 90px breaks 理想气体状态方程 into a clean 4+4; 符号 and 单位 are stable at their minimum; every formula and unit token stays intact; no header wraps.","problems":"说明 at 173px is just under the width needed to keep the short last note on one line, so all four body rows become two-line 60px rows and the table grows to 275px. 公式 at 112px is exactly at its one-line threshold, leaving no breathing room around the math.","cause":"The 173px 说明 column directly causes the extra row height; 112px 公式 is the minimum that fits the 91px longest formula, so any tighter width would split a formula."},{"design":"r2B","good":"Most compact at 252px; the short last note fits on one line, formulas and headers remain intact, and the table reads quickly.","problems":"物理量 at 84px is the tightest of the three and leaves the long quantity name close to the cell padding; the one-line final row makes the bottom edge feel abruptly lighter than the three two-line rows above; 公式 at 112px has no slack.","cause":"Taking 179px for 说明 bought the one-line last row, but it came out of 物理量 (84px) and 公式 (112px), so the identifying column is cramped and the formula column is threshold-tight."},{"design":"r2C","good":"Best overall balance: 物理量 still breaks 4+4, 公式 at 119px has about 7px slack, and 说明 at 172px keeps all body rows at two lines, producing even 60px rows and a calm grid.","problems":"物理量 at 84px remains at its tight minimum; 公式 at 119px is slightly over-generous relative to the 91px longest formula, while 说明 at 172px is just below the one-line threshold for the shortest note, so row 4 wraps and the table stays 275px.","cause":"The extra 7px in 公式 improves math comfort but does not change line count; 说明 at 172px is the boundary that forces the last note onto a second line."}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r3-balanced","widths":[88,52,116,52,171],"change":"Refines r2C by moving 4px from 说明 to 物理量 and 3px from 公式 to 物理量. This gives the row-label column breathing room, keeps 公式 above the 91px longest token (95px content), and keeps 说明 at 171px so the even two-line row rhythm and 275px height are preserved."},{"name":"r3-compact","widths":[87,52,112,52,176],"change":"Refines r2B by giving 3px to 物理量 and taking 3px from 说明. 说明 at 176px still has enough width for the short last note to stay on one line, while the label column is less cramped; 公式 stays at the proven 112px minimum."},{"name":"r3-label-forward","widths":[92,52,112,52,171],"change":"New emphasis: put the extra width into 物理量 (92px) so the row labels dominate the first scan, while holding 公式 at the proven 112px and 说明 at 171px. This tests whether label prominence is worth more than extra math breathing room; all formulas still fit."}]}
